name: briefbar-sessions
description: Lets BriefBar send a prompt to one of the GitHub Copilot app's sessions, fork the session and send the prompt to the fork, or stop the session's turn, when you ask it to in BriefBar. It runs a small extension in each session, which does nothing else. It comes with BriefBar.app, which installs it when you turn on Send Prompts to Copilot Sessions in Settings › Agents, and updates it with itself.
